brief.claim: Trial-by-trial neural activity in a frontal region is positively related to reaction time: the correlation between activity and reaction time is greater than zero at the one-sided 0.05 level.

data_keys.meaning: reaction time on each trial, trials in time order within a participant
frontal activity estimate on the same trial

brief.sizes: 12 participants, 25 trials each (300 trials in total).
